bagPolicy.summary: Bags up to 12"x14" are allowed inside Prudential Center, but backpacks of any size are not permitted. Larger bags are not allowed except for childcare or medical bags, which will be X-rayed.
prohibited: Bags larger than 12"x14" except for childcare or medical bags
bagPolicy.note: Childcare or medical bags are exceptions and will be X-rayed.

parking.note: Prudential Center offers several parking options including the Parking Deck presented by Hyundai and Green Street Garage. BMW owners can enjoy complimentary parking for select events, while Hyundai owners have access to reserved spaces. It's recommended to reserve parking in advance.

rideshare.note: A dedicated rideshare zone was not confirmed in Prudential Center's current published guidance. Follow the event page and your rideshare app on show day, and use only signed pickup or drop-off areas.

concessions.note: Prudential Center offers a diverse range of food and drink options, including burgers, hot dogs, chicken, Mexican, pizza, and desserts. Highlights include Smash by Pat LaFrieda, Mighty Quinn, and Melba's. Special offerings include a kosher section and Popcorn For The People.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Please visit our Guest Services Center located outside Section 9 on the Main Concourse and request an Assistive Listening Device. Sensory bags containing special KCVIP badges, fidget toys, noise cancelling headphones and other resources, are available for checkout (at no cost by leaving an ID) at our Guest Services Booths located behind Section 9 and 114.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: A venue-wide re-entry rule was not confirmed in Prudential Center's current published guidance. Treat exit as final unless event staff explicitly confirms re-entry before you leave.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: Will Call windows are located at the Ticketmaster Box Office at Prudential Center. (with the exception of an event on a Saturday or Sunday, then the box office opens at 11am)

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: All ticket holders are welcome to watch pre-game warm-ups for all Devils regular season games from the time doors open through the end of warm-ups (approximately 20 minutes prior to puck drop.)
